La clave es el texto en español tal como aparece en el sitio; el valor, su versión en inglés. build.py la aplica sobre los nodos de texto y los atributos alt, title, content, placeholder y aria-label: por eso las claves tienen que coincidir con el texto completo del nodo, no con un pedazo. Historia, sede, camiseta y comisión dire: History, home ground, kit and board of Centro Atlético Lito, founded in Montevideo in 1917.
Nacimos el 24 de julio de 1917 en un caf: We were born on 24 July 1917 in a café in Arroyo Seco. We disappeared, we came back, and we are writing what comes next.
En un café de Arroyo Seco, con el nombre: In a café in Arroyo Seco, named after the man behind the counter.
El nombre salió del mostrador. Manuel Se: The name came from behind the counter. Manuel Semino was «Lito» to the whole neighbourhood, and his café, at Agraciada and Santa Fe, was where Arroyo Seco met. When the regulars decided to found a club on 24 July 1917, they gave it the café's name.
La primera camiseta fue azul eléctrico c: The first shirt was electric blue with red trim and white shorts, with the crest over the left breast. That is where the nickname comes from: the blue and red of Arroyo Seco. Today's shirt follows the same line: French blue, red collar and red trim on the sleeves.
Un club nace de un barrio antes que de u: A club is born of a neighbourhood before it is born of a document. Lito never moved: the same grid of streets that led to the café leads to the pitch today.
El café de la esquina de Agraciada y San: The corner café at Agraciada and Santa Fe, where the club was founded
El café de Agraciada y Santa Fe. De ese: The café at Agraciada and Santa Fe. The name came from that counter.
A las diez de la noche del 24 de julio d: At ten at night on 24 July 1917, chaired ad hoc by Juan Pérez (son), the assembly unanimously approved the founding of «a centre for sporting and recreational purposes». The club's minute book opens with that page.

Ocho temporadas en la Primera del fútbol: Eight seasons in the top flight of Uruguayan football and three world champions who came through here.
Afiliado a la AUF, Lito ganó la Division: Affiliated to the AUF, Lito won the Divisional Extra in 1919 and the Intermedia in 1920. Two promotions in a row put the club in the 1921 Uruguayan Championship, where it stayed until 1928. Its best seasons were 1922 and 1923: fifth place, among the big clubs.
Cuando el fútbol se profesionalizó en 19: When football turned professional in 1932, the club stayed amateur and played in the lower divisions until it vanished from official competition around 1947. From 1952 it played again in the Uruguayan Amateur Football Federation, driven by Vicente Cappuccio's sons: two titles and two runners-up finishes. It stopped competing in 1960. Then, silence.
